problem.key_question: How can Vardhan restore EBITDA margin from 10.9% to at least 15% within 24 months without slowing growth?
problem.decision_maker: Board of directors, on the CEO's recommendation
success_criteria: Margin of 15% or more by FY27
Plan funded within existing capex envelope
problem.scope: All five plants and four product lines. Excludes M&A.

issue_tree.question: How can Vardhan restore EBITDA margin to 15% within 24 months?

children.question: Why has margin fallen despite growth?
children.hypothesis: Input-cost pass-through and mix, not volume

children.question: Which P&L drivers explain the decline?
How do we compare with peers, and where is the gap?
children.hypothesis: Conversion cost and OEE, concentrated in two plants

children.question: Which cost drivers lag the peer median?
How much can we recover, and from where?
children.hypothesis: More than ₹200 crore, mostly plant operations plus contracts

children.question: What causes the OEE loss at the worst plant?
What is the value at stake by lever and plant?
What should we do first, and what margin does it deliver?
children.hypothesis: Commercial quick wins first, plant turnarounds next, 15% needs a portfolio call

children.question: What margin does the plan deliver?

governing_thought: Margin can recover to {fy27_margin} within 24 months through seven levers, and reach 15% with a portfolio decision on machined components
situation: Revenue grew {revenue_growth_pct} from FY22 to FY25 on new EV and export programmes
complication: EBITDA margin fell {margin_drop_bps} bps to {margin_fy25}, and we now trail peers on {kpis_worse} of six cost drivers
resolution: Capture {value_at_stake} across seven levers in three waves and decide the future of machined components

rows.label: Diagnosis
rows.lead: Margin fell {margin_drop_bps} bps in three years
rows.text: while revenue grew {revenue_growth_pct}. Raw-material pass-through lag and a mix shift to machined components explain {bridge_top2_bps} bps of the decline.

rows.label: Benchmark
rows.lead: We trail the peer median on {kpis_worse} of six cost drivers,
rows.text: most on conversion cost ({conv_gap_pct} against median) and OEE. Pune and Chakan account for {plant_gap_share} of the conversion-cost gap.

rows.label: Potential
rows.lead: {value_at_stake} of annual EBITDA is at stake
rows.text: across seven levers: {ops_value} in plant operations, {pune_chakan_share} of it at Pune and Chakan, and {commercial_value} in contracts, price and mix.

rows.label: Plan
rows.lead: Three waves lift margin to {fy27_margin} by FY27.
rows.text: Closing the last {target_gap_bps} bps to 15% requires a decision on the machined-components portfolio.
